messages:
sanjay: Heads up — flightdeck shows token-latency sums not matching billing token counts. P95 token latency spikes on /generate but billing cost-per-token looks flat. Anyone digging?
evie: I noticed this around 09:10 PT. Kernel-selection traces show ~2.7% of requests falling back to a generic kernel in the last hour, which would inflate token exec time.
lia: can you paste a profiler sample?
sanjay: snippet: ```json
{ "model": "redwood-13b-quant", "seq_len": 1024, "chosen_kernel": "generic_matmul", "reason": "fallback_unoptimized" }
```
matt: that would explain the regression — generic kernel >2x token exec time. We need a metric token_exec_time bucketed by kernel_variant and seq_len_bin.
yara: KV cache hit-rate also dropped at the same time (evictions spiked). Cold misses + additional batch wait made tail worse. We should instrument per-route KV_hit_rate + cold_miss_latency.
evie: also a billing mismatch: flightdeck token counter currently counts input+output tokens differently than billing (we're double-counting prefix tokens for some routes). That explains the aggregate delta.
lia: proposed instrumentation changes:
1) emit per-token stage timers: wait_in_queue, kernel_exec, kv_lookup, serialization
2) tag metrics by route+model+kernel_variant
3) expose histograms (p10/p50/p95/p99) per-token stage
4) emit both flightdeck_token_count and billing_token_count (billing definition) so dashboards can align

infra-bot: canary deploy queued: perf-metrics v3.2 -> /deploy perf-metrics --canary=10%
matt: sample Prometheus export we can use:
```
llm_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/generate",model="r13q",kernel="matmul_opt",stage="kernel_exec",le="0.002"} 123
llm_token_latency_seconds_sum{route="/generate",model="r13q",kernel="matmul_opt",stage="kernel_exec"} 0.93
llm_token_ops_total{route="/generate",model="r13q",kernel="matmul_opt"} 4567
```
yara: add KV-specific gauges: kv_cache_entries{model=...,route=...} and kv_hit_ratio{model=...,route=...} and kv_cold_miss_latency_seconds histogram.
evie: dashboard tiles to add: per-route token CPI (cost per 1k tokens using billing_token_count), token-latency waterfall (stacked by stages), kernel-selection heatmap by seq_len_bin, kv hit trend and eviction spikes.
sanjay: owners: evie -> metrics rollout, matt -> runtime hooks, lia -> dashboard. ETA: metrics emitted next week, dashboard two-week rollout.
lia: reminder — billing token definition excludes system prompt tokens for enterprise customers. We'll need a feature-flag to switch counting behavior per-account.
matt: I'll instrument runtime to emit both counters: flightdeck_tokens and billing_tokens (label: billing_scope="enterprise|default"). Also will add kernel_variant label where possible.
yara: can we add an alert: kernel_fallback_rate > 1% sustained for >5m -> page?
ops-bot: created alert PERF_KERNEL_FALLBACK (threshold: 1% over 5m).
evie: I'll sync with finance to map cost-per-1k_tokens metric to actual billing rates so product can see unit economics.
sanjay: schedule follow-up: tomorrow 11:00am PT to align on rollout steps and owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
_notes: single Slack thread string; messages in chronological order; short informal style with code blocks and bot messages
